descriptions.zh: 通过释放臭臭的气味， 在攻击的时候， 有时会使对手畏缩。
descriptions.hgss: The stench helps keep wild Pokémon away.

effect.short: Has a 10% chance of making target Pokémon flinch with each hit.
effect.full: This Pokémon's damaging moves have a 10% chance to make the target flinch with each hit if they do not already cause flinching as a secondary effect. This ability does not stack with a held item. Overworld: The wild encounter rate is halved while this Pokémon is first in the party.

descriptions.zh: 出场时， 会将天气变为下雨。
descriptions.hgss: The Pokémon makes it rain if it appears in battle.

effect.short: Summons rain that lasts indefinitely upon entering battle.
effect.full: The weather changes to rain when this Pokémon enters battle and does not end unless replaced by another weather condition. If multiple Pokémon with this ability, Drought, Sand Stream, or Snow Warning are sent out at the same time, the abilities will activate in order of Speed, respecting Trick Room. Each ability's weather will cancel the previous weather, and only the weather summoned by the slowest of the Pokémon will stay.

descriptions.zh: 每一回合速度会变快。
descriptions.hgss: Its Speed stat is gradually boosted.

effect.short: Raises Speed one stage after each turn.
effect.full: This Pokémon's Speed rises one stage after each turn.

descriptions.zh: 被坚硬的甲壳守护着， 不会被对手的攻击击中要害。
descriptions.hgss: The Pokémon is protected against critical hits.

effect.short: Protects against critical hits.
effect.full: Moves cannot score critical hits against this Pokémon. This ability functions identically to Shell Armor.

descriptions.zh: 即使受到对手的招式攻击， 也不会被一击打倒。 一击必杀的招式也没有效果。
descriptions.hgss: It is protected against 1-hit KO attacks.

effect.short: Prevents being KOed from full HP, leaving 1 HP instead. Protects against the one-hit KO moves regardless of HP.
effect.full: When this Pokémon is at full HP, any hit that would knock it out will instead leave it with 1 HP. Regardless of its current HP, it is also immune to the one-hit KO moves: Fissure, Guillotine, Horn Drill, and Sheer Cold. If this Pokémon is holding a Focus Sash, this ability takes precedence and the item will not be consumed.

descriptions.zh: 通过把周围都弄湿， 使谁都无法使用自爆等爆炸类的招式。
descriptions.hgss: Prevents combatants from self-destructing.

effect.short: Prevents Self-Destruct, Explosion, and Aftermath from working while the Pokémon is in battle.
effect.full: While this Pokémon is in battle, Self-Destruct and Explosion will fail and Aftermath will not take effect.

descriptions.zh: 因为身体柔软， 不会变为麻痹状态。
descriptions.hgss: The Pokémon is protected from paralysis.

effect.short: Prevents paralysis.
effect.full: This Pokémon cannot be paralyzed. If a Pokémon is paralyzed and acquires this ability, its paralysis is healed; this includes when regaining a lost ability upon leaving battle.

descriptions.zh: 在沙暴的时候， 闪避率会提高。
descriptions.hgss: Boosts the Pokémon’s evasion in a sandstorm.

effect.short: Increases evasion to 1.25× during a sandstorm. Protects against sandstorm damage.
effect.full: During a sandstorm, this Pokémon has 1.25× its evasion, and it does not take sandstorm damage regardless of type. The evasion bonus does not count as a stat modifier. Overworld: If the lead Pokémon has this ability, the wild encounter rate is halved in a sandstorm.

descriptions.zh: 身上带有静电， 有时会让接触到的对手麻痹。
descriptions.hgss: Contact with the Pokémon may cause paralysis.

effect.short: Has a 30% chance of paralyzing attacking Pokémon on contact.
effect.full: Whenever a move makes contact with this Pokémon, the move's user has a 30% chance of being paralyzed. Pokémon that are immune to Electric-type moves can still be paralyzed by this ability. Overworld: If the lead Pokémon has this ability, there is a 50% chance that encounters will be with an Electric Pokémon, if applicable.

descriptions.zh: 受到电属性的招式攻击时， 不会受到伤害，而是会回复。
descriptions.hgss: Restores HP if hit by an Electric-type move.

effect.short: Absorbs Electric moves, healing for 1/4 max HP.
effect.full: Whenever an Electric-type move hits this Pokémon, it heals for 1/4 of its maximum HP, negating any other effect on it. This ability will not take effect if this Pokémon is Ground-type and thus immune to Electric moves. Electric moves will ignore this Pokémon's Substitute. This effect includes non-damaging moves, i.e. Thunder Wave.

descriptions.zh: 受到水属性的招式攻击时， 不会受到伤害，而是会回复。
descriptions.hgss: Restores HP if hit by a Water-type move.

effect.short: Absorbs Water moves, healing for 1/4 max HP.
effect.full: Whenever a Water-type move hits this Pokémon, it heals for 1/4 of its maximum HP, negating any other effect on it. Water moves will ignore this Pokémon's Substitute.

descriptions.zh: 因为感觉迟钝， 不会变为着迷和被挑衅状态。
descriptions.hgss: Prevents it from becoming infatuated.

effect.short: Prevents infatuation and protects against Captivate.
effect.full: This Pokémon cannot be infatuated and is immune to Captivate. If a Pokémon is infatuated and acquires this ability, its infatuation is cleared.

descriptions.zh: 任何天气的影响都会消失。
descriptions.hgss: Eliminates the effects of weather.

effect.short: Negates all effects of weather, but does not prevent the weather itself.
effect.full: While this Pokémon is in battle, weather can still be in play, but will not have any of its effects. This ability functions identically to Air Lock.

descriptions.zh: 因为拥有复眼， 招式的命中率会提高。
descriptions.hgss: The Pokémon’s accuracy is boosted.

effect.short: Increases moves' accuracy to 1.3×.
effect.full: This Pokémon's moves have 1.3× their accuracy. This ability has no effect on the one-hit KO moves (Fissure, Guillotine, Horn Drill, and Sheer Cold). Overworld: If the first Pokémon in the party has this ability, the chance of a wild Pokémon holding a particular item is raised from 50%, 5%, or 1% to 60%, 20%, or 5%, respectively.

descriptions.zh: 因为有着睡不着的体质， 所以不会陷入睡眠状态。
descriptions.hgss: Prevents the Pokémon from falling asleep.

effect.short: Prevents sleep.
effect.full: This Pokémon cannot be asleep. This causes Rest to fail altogether. If a Pokémon is asleep and acquires this ability, it will immediately wake up; this includes when regaining a lost ability upon leaving battle. This ability functions identically to Vital Spirit in battle.

descriptions.zh: 自己的属性会变为 从对手处所受招式的属性。
descriptions.hgss: Changes the Pokémon’s type to the foe’s move.

effect.short: Changes type to match when hit by a damaging move.
effect.full: Whenever this Pokémon takes damage from a move, the Pokémon's type changes to match the move. If the Pokémon has two types, both are overridden. The Pokémon must directly take damage; for example, moves blocked by a Substitute will not trigger this ability, nor will moves that deal damage indirectly, such as Spikes. This ability takes effect on only the last hit of a multiple-hit attack. In Pokémon Colosseum and XD: Gale of Darkness, this ability does not take effect on Shadow-type moves.

descriptions.zh: 因为体内拥有免疫能力， 不会变为中毒状态。
descriptions.hgss: Prevents the Pokémon from getting poisoned.

effect.short: Prevents poison.
effect.full: This Pokémon cannot be poisoned. This includes bad poison. If a Pokémon is poisoned and acquires this ability, its poison is healed; this includes when regaining a lost ability upon leaving battle.

descriptions.zh: 受到火属性的招式攻击时， 吸收火焰，自己使出的 火属性招式会变强。
descriptions.hgss: It powers up Fire-type moves if it’s hit by one.

effect.short: Protects against Fire moves. Once one has been blocked, the Pokémon's own Fire moves inflict 1.5× damage until it leaves battle.
effect.full: This Pokémon is immune to Fire-type moves. Once this Pokémon has been hit by a Fire move, its own Fire moves will inflict 1.5× as much damage until it leaves battle. This ability has no effect while the Pokémon is frozen. The Fire damage bonus is retained even if the Pokémon is frozen and thawed or the ability is lost or disabled. Fire moves will ignore this Pokémon's Substitute. This ability takes effect even on non-damaging moves, i.e. Will-O-Wisp.

descriptions.zh: 被鳞粉守护着， 不会受到招式的追加效果影响。
descriptions.hgss: Blocks the added effects of attacks taken.

effect.short: Protects against incoming moves' extra effects.
effect.full: This Pokémon is immune to the extra effects of moves used against it. An extra effect is a move's chance, listed as an "effect chance", to inflict a status ailment, cause a stat change, or make the target flinch in addition to the move's main effect. For example, Thunder Shock's paralysis is an extra effect, but Thunder Wave's is not, nor are Knock Off's item removal and Air Cutter's increased critical hit rate.

descriptions.zh: 因为我行我素， 不会变为混乱状态。
descriptions.hgss: Prevents the Pokémon from becoming confused.

effect.short: Prevents confusion.
effect.full: This Pokémon cannot be confused. If a Pokémon is confused and acquires this ability, its confusion will immediately be healed.

descriptions.zh: 用吸盘牢牢贴在地面上， 让替换宝可梦的招式和道具无效。
descriptions.hgss: Negates foes’ moves that force switching out.

effect.short: Prevents being forced out of battle by other Pokémon's moves.
effect.full: This Pokémon cannot be forced out of battle by moves such as Whirlwind. Dragon Tail and Circle Throw still inflict damage against this Pokémon. Overworld: If the lead Pokémon has this ability, the success rate while fishing is increased.

descriptions.zh: 出场时威吓对手， 让其退缩， 降低对手的攻击。
descriptions.hgss: Lowers the foe’s Attack stat.

effect.short: Lowers opponents' Attack one stage upon entering battle.
effect.full: When this Pokémon enters battle, the opponent's Attack is lowered by one stage. In a double battle, both opponents are affected. This ability also takes effect when acquired during a battle, but will not take effect again if lost and reobtained without leaving battle. This ability has no effect on an opponent that has a Substitute. Overworld: If the first Pokémon in the party has this ability, any random encounter with a Pokémon five or more levels lower than it has a 50% chance of being skipped.

descriptions.zh: 踩住对手的影子 使其无法逃走或替换。
descriptions.hgss: Prevents the foe from escaping.

effect.short: Prevents opponents from fleeing or switching out.
effect.full: While this Pokémon is in battle, opposing Pokémon cannot flee or switch out. Other Pokémon with this ability are unaffected. Pokémon with Run Away can still flee. Pokémon can still switch out with the use of a move or item.

descriptions.zh: 受到攻击时， 用粗糙的皮肤弄伤 接触到自己的对手。
descriptions.hgss: Inflicts damage to the foe on contact.

effect.short: Damages attacking Pokémon for 1/8 their max HP on contact.
effect.full: Whenever a move makes contact with this Pokémon, the move's user takes 1/8 of its maximum HP in damage. This ability functions identically to Iron Barbs.

descriptions.zh: 不可思议的力量， 只有效果绝佳的招式才能击中。
descriptions.hgss: Only supereffective moves will hit.

effect.short: Protects against damaging moves that are not super effective.
effect.full: This Pokémon is immune to damaging moves that are not super effective against it. Moves that inflict fixed damage, such as Night Shade or Seismic Toss, are considered super effective if their types are. Damage not directly dealt by moves, such as damage from weather, a status ailment, or Spikes, is not prevented. This ability cannot be copied with Role Play or traded away with Skill Swap, but it can be copied with Trace, disabled with Gastro Acid, or changed with Worry Seed. This Pokémon can still use Role Play itself to lose this ability, but not Skill Swap. If this Pokémon has a Substitute, this ability will block moves as usual and any moves not blocked will react to the Substitute as usual.

descriptions.zh: 从地面浮起， 从而不会受到地面属性招式的攻击。
descriptions.hgss: Gives full immunity to all Ground-type moves.

effect.short: Evades Ground moves.
effect.full: This Pokémon is immune to Ground-type moves, Spikes, Toxic Spikes, and Arena Trap. This ability is disabled during Gravity or Ingrain, or while holding an Iron Ball. This ability is not disabled during Roost.

descriptions.zh: 受到攻击时， 有时会把接触到自己的对手 变为中毒、麻痹或睡眠状态。
descriptions.hgss: Contact may paralyze, poison, or cause sleep.

effect.short: Has a 30% chance of inflcting either paralysis, poison, or sleep on attacking Pokémon on contact.
effect.full: Whenever a move makes contact with this Pokémon, the move's user has a 30% chance of being paralyzed, poisoned, or put to sleep, chosen at random. Nothing is done to compensate if the move's user is immune to one of these ailments; there is simply a lower chance that the move's user will be affected.

descriptions.zh: 将自己的中毒、麻痹 或灼伤状态传染给对手。
descriptions.hgss: Passes a burn, poison, or paralysis to the foe.

effect.short: Copies burns, paralysis, and poison received onto the Pokémon that inflicted them.
effect.full: Whenever this Pokémon is burned, paralyzed, or poisoned, the Pokémon who gave this Pokémon that ailment is also given the ailment. This ability passes back bad poison when this Pokémon is badly poisoned. This ability cannot pass on a status ailment that the Pokémon did not directly receive from another Pokémon, such as the poison from Toxic Spikes or the burn from a Flame Orb. Overworld: If the lead Pokémon has this ability, wild Pokémon have a 50% chance of having the lead Pokémon's nature, and a 50% chance of being given a random nature as usual, including the lead Pokémon's nature. This does not work on Pokémon received outside of battle or roaming legendaries.

descriptions.zh: 不会因为对手的招式或特性 而被降低能力。
descriptions.hgss: Prevents its stats from being lowered.

effect.short: Prevents stats from being lowered by other Pokémon.
effect.full: This Pokémon cannot have its stats lowered by other Pokémon. This ability does not prevent any stat losses other than stat modifiers, such as the Speed cut from paralysis. This Pokémon can still be passed negative stat modifiers through Guard Swap, Heart Swap, or Power Swap. This ability functions identically to White Smoke in battle.

descriptions.zh: 回到同行队伍后， 异常状态就会被治愈。
descriptions.hgss: All status problems heal when it switches out.

effect.short: Cures any major status ailment upon switching out.
effect.full: This Pokémon is cured of any major status ailment when it is switched out for another Pokémon. If this ability is acquired during battle, the Pokémon is cured upon leaving battle before losing the temporary ability.

descriptions.zh: 将电属性的招式吸引到自己身上， 不会受到伤害，而是会提高特攻。
descriptions.hgss: The Pokémon draws in all Electric-type moves.

effect.short: Redirects single-target Electric moves to this Pokémon where possible. Absorbs Electric moves, raising Special Attack one stage.
effect.full: All other Pokémon's single-target Electric-type moves are redirected to this Pokémon if it is an eligible target. Other Pokémon's Electric moves raise this Pokémon's Special Attack one stage, negating any other effect on it, and cannot miss it. If the move's intended target also has this ability, the move is not redirected. When multiple Pokémon with this ability are possible targets for redirection, the move is redirected to the one with the highest Speed stat, or, in the case of a tie, to a random tied Pokémon. Follow Me takes precedence over this ability. If the Pokémon is a Ground-type and thus immune to Electric moves, its immunity prevents the Special Attack boost.

descriptions.zh: 托天恩的福， 招式的追加效果容易出现。
descriptions.hgss: Boosts the likelihood of added effects appearing.

effect.short: Doubles the chance of moves' extra effects occurring.
effect.full: This Pokémon's moves have twice their usual effect chance. An effect chance is a move's chance to inflict a status ailment, cause a stat change, or make the target flinch in addition to the move's main effect. For example, Flamethrower's chance of burning the target is doubled, but Protect's chance of success and Air Cutter's increased critical hit rate are unaffected. Secret Power is unaffected.

descriptions.zh: 下雨天气时， 速度会提高。
descriptions.hgss: Boosts the Pokémon’s Speed in rain.

effect.short: Doubles Speed during rain.
effect.full: This Pokémon's Speed is doubled during rain. This bonus does not count as a stat modifier.

descriptions.zh: 晴朗天气时， 速度会提高。
descriptions.hgss: Boosts the Pokémon’s Speed in sunshine.

effect.short: Doubles Speed during strong sunlight.
effect.full: This Pokémon's Speed is doubled during strong sunlight. This bonus does not count as a stat modifier.

descriptions.zh: 通过让周围变亮， 变得容易遇到野生的宝可梦。
descriptions.hgss: Raises the likelihood of meeting wild Pokémon.

effect.short: Doubles the wild encounter rate.
effect.full: Overworld: If the lead Pokémon has this ability, the wild encounter rate is doubled. This ability has no effect in battle.

descriptions.zh: 出场时，复制对手的特性， 变为与之相同的特性。
descriptions.hgss: The Pokémon copies the foe’s ability.

effect.short: Copies an opponent's ability upon entering battle.
effect.full: When this Pokémon enters battle, it copies a random opponent's ability. This ability cannot copy Flower Gift, Forecast, Illusion, Imposter, Multitype, Trace, or Zen Mode.

descriptions.zh: 物理攻击的威力会变为２倍。
descriptions.hgss: Raises the Pokémon’s Attack stat.

effect.short: Doubles Attack in battle.
effect.full: This Pokémon's Attack is doubled while in battle. This bonus does not count as a stat modifier. This ability functions identically to Pure Power.

descriptions.zh: 有时会让接触到自己的 对手变为中毒状态。
descriptions.hgss: Contact with the Pokémon may poison the foe.

effect.short: Has a 30% chance of poisoning attacking Pokémon on contact.
effect.full: Whenever a move makes contact with this Pokémon, the move's user has a 30% chance of being poisoned.

descriptions.zh: 拥有经过锻炼的精神， 而不会因对手的攻击而畏缩。
descriptions.hgss: The Pokémon is protected from flinching.

effect.short: Prevents flinching.
effect.full: This Pokémon cannot flinch.

descriptions.zh: 将炽热的熔岩覆盖在身上， 不会变为冰冻状态。
descriptions.hgss: Prevents the Pokémon from becoming frozen.

effect.short: Prevents freezing.
effect.full: This Pokémon cannot be frozen. If a Pokémon is frozen and acquires this ability, it will immediately thaw out; this includes when regaining a lost ability upon leaving battle. Overworld: If any Pokémon in the party has this ability, each egg in the party has its hatch counter decreased by 2 (rather than 1) each step cycle, making eggs hatch roughly twice as quickly. This effect does not stack if multiple Pokémon have this ability or Flame Body.

descriptions.zh: 将水幕裹在身上， 不会变为灼伤状态。
descriptions.hgss: Prevents the Pokémon from getting a burn.

effect.short: Prevents burns.
effect.full: This Pokémon cannot be burned. If a Pokémon is burned and acquires this ability, its burn is healed; this includes when regaining a lost ability upon leaving battle.

descriptions.zh: 用磁力吸住钢属性的宝可梦， 使其无法逃走。
descriptions.hgss: Prevents Steel-type Pokémon from escaping.

effect.short: Prevents Steel opponents from fleeing or switching out.
effect.full: While this Pokémon is in battle, opposing Steel-type Pokémon cannot flee or switch out. Pokémon with Run Away can still flee. Pokémon can still switch out with the use of a move or item. Overworld: If the lead Pokémon has this ability, Steel-type Pokémon have a higher encounter rate.

descriptions.zh: 通过屏蔽声音， 不受到声音招式的攻击。
descriptions.hgss: Gives full immunity to all sound-based moves.

effect.short: Protects against sound-based moves.
effect.full: This Pokémon is immune to moves flagged as being sound-based. Heal Bell is unaffected. Uproar still prevents this Pokémon from sleeping. This Pokémon can still receive a Perish Song counter through Baton Pass, and will retain a Perish Song counter if it acquires this ability after Perish Song is used. Howl, Roar of Time, Sonic Boom, and Yawn are not flagged as sound-based.

descriptions.zh: 下雨天气时， 会缓缓回复ＨＰ。
descriptions.hgss: The Pokémon gradually recovers HP in rain.

effect.short: Heals for 1/16 max HP after each turn during rain.
effect.full: This Pokémon heals for 1/16 of its maximum HP after each turn during rain.

descriptions.zh: 出场时， 会把天气变为沙暴。
descriptions.hgss: The Pokémon summons a sandstorm in battle.

effect.short: Summons a sandstorm that lasts indefinitely upon entering battle.
effect.full: The weather changes to a sandstorm when this Pokémon enters battle and does not end unless cancelled by another weather condition. If multiple Pokémon with this ability, Drizzle, Drought, or Snow Warning are sent out at the same time, the abilities will activate in order of Speed, respecting Trick Room. Each ability's weather will cancel the previous weather, and only the weather summoned by the slowest of the Pokémon will stay. Overworld: If the lead Pokémon has this ability, the wild encounter rate is halved in a sandstorm.

descriptions.zh: 给予对手压迫感， 大量减少其使用招式的ＰＰ。
descriptions.hgss: The Pokémon raises the foe’s PP usage.

effect.short: Increases the PP cost of moves targetting the Pokémon by one.
effect.full: Moves targetting this Pokémon use one extra PP. This ability stacks if multiple targets have it. This ability still affects moves that fail or miss. This ability does not affect ally moves that target either the entire field or just its side, nor this Pokémon's self-targetted moves; it does, however, affect single-targetted ally moves aimed at this Pokémon, ally moves that target all other Pokémon, and opponents' moves that target the entire field. If this ability raises a move's PP cost above its remaining PP, it will use all remaining PP. When this Pokémon enters battle, all participating trainers are notified that it has this ability. Overworld: If the lead Pokémon has this ability, higher-levelled Pokémon have their encounter rate increased.

descriptions.zh: 因为被厚厚的脂肪保护着， 会让火属性和冰属性的招式伤害减半。
descriptions.hgss: Ups resistance to Fire-​ and Ice-type moves.

effect.short: Halves damage from Fire and Ice moves.
effect.full: This Pokémon takes half as much damage from Fire- and Ice-type moves.

descriptions.zh: 即使变为睡眠状态， 也能以２倍的速度提早醒来。
descriptions.hgss: The Pokémon awakens quickly from sleep.

effect.short: Makes sleep pass twice as quickly.
effect.full: This Pokémon's remaining sleep turn count falls by 2 rather than 1. If this Pokémon's sleep counter is at 1, it will fall to 0 and then the Pokémon will wake up.

descriptions.zh: 有时会让接触到自己的 对手变为灼伤状态。
descriptions.hgss: Contact with the Pokémon may burn the foe.

effect.short: Has a 30% chance of burning attacking Pokémon on contact.
effect.full: Whenever a move makes contact with this Pokémon, the move's user has a 30% chance of being burned. Overworld: If any Pokémon in the party has this ability, each egg in the party has its hatch counter decreased by 2 (rather than 1) each step cycle, making eggs hatch roughly twice as quickly. This effect does not stack if multiple Pokémon have this ability or Magma Armor.

descriptions.zh: 一定能从野生宝可梦 那儿逃走。
descriptions.hgss: Enables sure getaway from wild Pokémon.

effect.short: Ensures success fleeing from wild battles.
effect.full: This Pokémon is always successful fleeing from wild battles, even if trapped by a move or ability.

descriptions.zh: 多亏了锐利的目光， 命中率不会被降低。
descriptions.hgss: Prevents the Pokémon from losing accuracy.

effect.short: Prevents accuracy from being lowered.
effect.full: This Pokémon cannot have its accuracy lowered. This ability does not prevent any accuracy losses other than stat modifiers, such as the accuracy cut from fog; nor does it prevent other Pokémon's evasion from making this Pokémon's moves less accurate. This Pokémon can still be passed negative accuracy modifiers through Heart Swap. Overworld: If the first Pokémon in the party has this ability, any random encounter with a Pokémon five or more levels lower than it has a 50% chance of being skipped.

descriptions.zh: 因为拥有以力量自豪的钳子， 不会被对手降低攻击。
descriptions.hgss: Prevents the Attack stat from being lowered.

effect.short: Prevents Attack from being lowered by other Pokémon.
effect.full: This Pokémon's Attack cannot be lowered by other Pokémon. This ability does not prevent any Attack losses other than stat modifiers, such as the Attack cut from a burn. This Pokémon can still be passed negative Attack modifiers through Heart Swap or Power Swap.

descriptions.zh: 有时会捡来对手用过的道具， 冒险过程中也会捡到。
descriptions.hgss: The Pokémon may pick up items.

effect.short: Picks up other Pokémon's used and Flung held items. May also pick up an item after battle.
effect.full: At the end of each turn, if another Pokémon consumed or Flung a held item that turn, this Pokémon picks up the item if it is not already holding one. After each battle, this Pokémon has a 10% chance of picking up an item if it is not already holding one. The Air Balloon and Eject Button cannot be picked up. The items that may be found vary by game, and, since Pokémon Emerald, by the Pokémon's level. This ability is checked after the battle ends, at which point any temporary ability changes have worn off.

descriptions.zh: 如果使出招式， 下一回合就会休息。
descriptions.hgss: Pokémon can’t attack on consecutive turns.

effect.short: Skips every second turn.
effect.full: Every second turn on which this Pokémon should attempt to use a move, it will instead do nothing ("loaf around"). Loafing around interrupts moves that take multiple turns the same way paralysis, flinching, etc do. Most such moves, for example Bide or Rollout, are simply cut off upon loafing around. Attacks with a recharge turn, such as Hyper Beam, do not have to recharge; attacks with a preparation turn, such as Fly, do not end up being used. Moves that are forced over multiple turns and keep going through failure, such as Outrage, Uproar, or any move forced by Encore, keep going as usual. If this Pokémon is confused, its confusion is not checked when loafing around; the Pokémon cannot hurt itself, and its confusion does not end or come closer to ending. If this Pokémon attempts to move but fails, e.g. because of paralysis or Gravity, it still counts as having moved and will loaf around the next turn. If it does not attempt to move, e.g. because it is asleep or frozen, whatever it would have done will be postponed until its next attempt; that is, it will either loaf around or move as usual, depending on what it last did. This ability cannot be changed with Worry Seed, but it can be disabled with Gastro Acid, changed with Role Play, or traded away with Skill Swap.

descriptions.zh: 自己的攻击变高， 但命中率会降低。
descriptions.hgss: Boosts the Attack stat, but lowers accuracy.

effect.short: Strengthens physical moves to inflict 1.5× damage, but decreases their accuracy to 0.8×.
effect.full: This Pokémon's physical moves do 1.5× as much regular damage, but have 0.8× their usual accuracy. Special moves are unaffected. Moves that do set damage, such as Seismic Toss, have their accuracy affected, but not their damage. Overworld: If the lead Pokémon has this ability, higher-levelled Pokémon have their encounter rate increased.

descriptions.zh: 有时会让接触到自己的对手着迷。
descriptions.hgss: Contact with the Pokémon may cause infatuation.

effect.short: Has a 30% chance of infatuating attacking Pokémon on contact.
effect.full: Whenever a move makes contact with this Pokémon, the move's user has a 30% chance of being infatuated. Overworld: If the first Pokémon in the party has this ability, any wild Pokémon whose species can be either gender has a 2/3 chance of being set to the opposite gender, and a 1/3 chance of having a random gender as usual.

descriptions.zh: 出场的伙伴之间 如果有正电或负电特性的宝可梦， 自己的特攻会提高。
descriptions.hgss: Ups Sp. Atk if another Pokémon has Minus.

effect.short: Increases Special Attack to 1.5× when a friendly Pokémon has Plus or Minus.
effect.full: This Pokémon has 1.5× its Special Attack if any friendly Pokémon has Plus or Minus. This bonus does not count as a stat modifier. If either ability is disabled by Gastro Acid, both lose their effect.

descriptions.zh: 出场的伙伴之间 如果有正电或负电特性的宝可梦， 自己的特攻会提高。
descriptions.hgss: Ups Sp. Atk if another Pokémon has Plus.

effect.short: Increases Special Attack to 1.5× when a friendly Pokémon has Plus or Minus.
effect.full: This Pokémon has 1.5× its Special Attack if any friendly Pokémon has Plus or Minus. This bonus does not count as a stat modifier. If either ability is disabled by Gastro Acid, both lose their effect.

descriptions.zh: 受天气的影响， 会变为水属性、火属性 或冰属性中的某一个。
descriptions.hgss: CASTFORM transforms with the weather.

effect.short: Changes Castform's type and form to match the weather.
effect.full: During rain, strong sunlight, or hail, this Pokémon's type changes to Water, Fire, or Ice, respectively, and its form changes to match. This ability has no effect for any Pokémon other than Castform. If the weather ends or becomes anything that does not trigger this ability, or a Pokémon with Air Lock or Cloud Nine enters battle, this Pokémon's type and form revert to their default. If this ability is lost or disabled, this Pokémon cannot change its current type and form until it regains its ability.

descriptions.zh: 因为道具是粘在黏性身体上的， 所以不会被对手夺走。
descriptions.hgss: Protects the Pokémon from item theft.

effect.short: Prevents a held item from being removed by other Pokémon.
effect.full: This Pokémon's hold item cannot be removed by other Pokémon. Damaging moves that would remove this Pokémon's item can still inflict damage against this Pokémon, e.g. Knock Off or Pluck. This Pokémon can still use moves that involve the loss of its own item, e.g. Fling or Trick. Overworld: If the lead Pokémon has this ability, the encounter rate while fishing is increased.

descriptions.zh: 通过蜕去身上的皮， 有时会治愈异常状态。
descriptions.hgss: The Pokémon may heal its own status problems.

effect.short: Has a 33% chance of curing any major status ailment after each turn.
effect.full: After each turn, this Pokémon has a 33% of being cured of any major status ailment.

descriptions.zh: 如果变为异常状态， 会拿出毅力， 攻击会提高。
descriptions.hgss: Boosts Attack if there is a status problem.

effect.short: Increases Attack to 1.5× with a major status ailment.
effect.full: Whenever this Pokémon is asleep, burned, paralyzed, or poisoned, it has 1.5× its Attack. This Pokémon is not affected by the usual Attack cut from a burn. This bonus does not count as a stat modifier.

descriptions.zh: 如果变为异常状态， 神奇鳞片会发生反应， 防御会提高。
descriptions.hgss: Ups Defense if there is a status problem.

effect.short: Increases Defense to 1.5× with a major status ailment.
effect.full: Whenever this Pokémon has a major status ailment, it has 1.5× its Defense. This bonus does not count as a stat modifier.

descriptions.zh: 吸收了污泥浆的对手 会因强烈的恶臭 而受到伤害，减少ＨＰ。
descriptions.hgss: Inflicts damage on foes using any draining move.

effect.short: Damages opponents using leeching moves for as much as they would heal.
effect.full: Whenever a Pokémon would heal after hitting this Pokémon with a leeching move like Absorb, it instead loses as many HP as it would usually gain. Dream Eater is unaffected.

descriptions.zh: ＨＰ减少的时候， 草属性的招式威力会提高。
descriptions.hgss: Powers up Grass-type moves in a pinch.

effect.short: Strengthens Grass moves to inflict 1.5× damage at 1/3 max HP or less.
effect.full: When this Pokémon has 1/3 or less of its HP remaining, its Grass-type moves inflict 1.5× as much regular damage.

descriptions.zh: ＨＰ减少的时候， 火属性的招式威力会提高。
descriptions.hgss: Powers up Fire-type moves in a pinch.

effect.short: Strengthens Fire moves to inflict 1.5× damage at 1/3 max HP or less.
effect.full: When this Pokémon has 1/3 or less of its HP remaining, its Fire-type moves inflict 1.5× as much regular damage.

descriptions.zh: ＨＰ减少的时候， 水属性的招式威力会提高。
descriptions.hgss: Powers up Water-type moves in a pinch.

effect.short: Strengthens Water moves to inflict 1.5× damage at 1/3 max HP or less.
effect.full: When this Pokémon has 1/3 or less of its HP remaining, its Water-type moves inflict 1.5× as much regular damage.

descriptions.zh: ＨＰ减少的时候， 虫属性的招式威力会提高。
descriptions.hgss: Powers up Bug-type moves in a pinch.

effect.short: Strengthens Bug moves to inflict 1.5× damage at 1/3 max HP or less.
effect.full: When this Pokémon has 1/3 or less of its HP remaining, its Bug-type moves inflict 1.5× as much regular damage. Overworld: If the lead Pokémon has this ability, the wild encounter rate is increased.

descriptions.zh: 即使使出会受反作用力伤害的招式， ＨＰ也不会减少。
descriptions.hgss: Protects the Pokémon from recoil damage.

effect.short: Protects against recoil damage.
effect.full: This Pokémon does not receive recoil damage from its recoil moves. Struggle's recoil is unaffected. This ability does not prevent crash damage from missing with Jump Kick or High Jump Kick.

descriptions.zh: 出场时， 会将天气变为晴朗。
descriptions.hgss: The Pokémon makes it sunny if it is in battle.

effect.short: Summons strong sunlight that lasts indefinitely upon entering battle.
effect.full: The weather changes to strong sunlight when this Pokémon enters battle and does not end unless cancelled by another weather condition. If multiple Pokémon with this ability, Drizzle, Sand Stream, or Snow Warning are sent out at the same time, the abilities will activate in order of Speed, respecting Trick Room. Each ability's weather will cancel the previous weather, and only the weather summoned by the slowest of the Pokémon will stay.

descriptions.zh: 在战斗中让对手无法逃走。
descriptions.hgss: Prevents the foe from fleeing.

effect.short: Prevents opponents from fleeing or switching out. Eluded by Flying-types and Pokémon in the air.
effect.full: While this Pokémon is in battle, opposing Pokémon cannot flee or switch out. Flying-type Pokémon and Pokémon in the air, e.g. due to Levitate or Magnet Rise, are unaffected. Pokémon with Run Away can still flee. Pokémon can still switch out with the use of a move or item. Overworld: If the lead Pokémon has this ability, the wild encounter rate is doubled.

descriptions.zh: 通过激发出干劲， 不会变为睡眠状态。
descriptions.hgss: Prevents the Pokémon from falling asleep.

effect.short: Prevents sleep.
effect.full: This Pokémon cannot be asleep. This causes Rest to fail altogether. If a Pokémon is asleep and acquires this ability, it will immediately wake up; this includes when regaining a lost ability upon leaving battle. This ability functions identically to Insomnia in battle. Overworld: If the lead Pokémon has this ability, higher-levelled Pokémon have their encounter rate increased.

descriptions.zh: 被白色烟雾保护着， 不会被对手降低能力。
descriptions.hgss: Prevents its stats from being lowered.

effect.short: Prevents stats from being lowered by other Pokémon.
effect.full: This Pokémon cannot have its stats lowered by other Pokémon. This ability does not prevent any stat losses other than stat modifiers, such as the Speed cut from paralysis; nor self-inflicted stat drops, such as the Special Attack drop from Overheat; nor opponent-triggered stat boosts, such as the Attack boost from Swagger. This Pokémon can still be passed negative stat modifiers through Guard Swap, Heart Swap, or Power Swap. This ability functions identically to Clear Body in battle. Overworld: If the lead Pokémon has this ability, the wild encounter rate is halved.

descriptions.zh: 因瑜伽的力量， 物理攻击的威力会变为２倍。
descriptions.hgss: Boosts the power of physical attacks.

effect.short: Doubles Attack in battle.
effect.full: This Pokémon's Attack is doubled in battle. This bonus does not count as a stat modifier. This ability functions identically to Huge Power.

descriptions.zh: 被坚硬的壳保护着， 对手的攻击不会击中要害。
descriptions.hgss: The Pokémon is protected against critical hits.

effect.short: Protects against critical hits.
effect.full: Moves cannot score critical hits against this Pokémon. This ability functions identically to Battle Armor.

descriptions.zh: 所有天气的影响都会消失。
descriptions.hgss: Eliminates the effects of weather.

effect.short: Negates all effects of weather, but does not prevent the weather itself.
effect.full: While this Pokémon is in battle, weather can still be in play, but will not have any of its effects. This ability functions identically to Cloud Nine.

descriptions.zh: 在混乱状态时， 闪避率会提高。
descriptions.hgss: Raises evasion if the Pokémon is confused.

effect.short: Doubles evasion when confused.
effect.full: When this Pokémon is confused, it has twice its evasion.

descriptions.zh: 受到电属性的招式攻击时， 不会受到伤害，而是速度会提高。
descriptions.hgss: Raises Speed if hit by an Electric-type move.

effect.short: Absorbs Electric moves, raising Speed one stage.
effect.full: Whenever an Electric-type move hits this Pokémon, its Speed rises one stage, negating any other effect on it. This ability will not take effect if this Pokémon is immune to Electric moves. Electric moves will ignore this Pokémon's Substitute. This effect includes non-damaging moves, i.e. Thunder Wave.

descriptions.zh: 面对性别相同的对手， 会燃起斗争心，变得更强。 而面对性别不同的，则会变弱。
descriptions.hgss: Raises Attack if the foe is of the same gender.

effect.short: Increases damage inflicted to 1.25× against Pokémon of the same gender, but decreases damage to 0.75× against the opposite gender.
effect.full: This Pokémon inflicts 1.25× as much regular damage against Pokémon of the same gender and 0.75× as much regular damage against Pokémon of the opposite gender. If either Pokémon is genderless, damage is unaffected.

descriptions.zh: 每次畏缩时， 不屈之心就会燃起， 速度也会提高。
descriptions.hgss: Raises Speed each time the Pokémon flinches.

effect.short: Raises Speed one stage upon flinching.
effect.full: Whenever this Pokémon flinches, its Speed rises one stage.

descriptions.zh: 冰雹天气时， 闪避率会提高。
descriptions.hgss: Raises evasion in a hailstorm.

effect.short: Increases evasion to 1.25× during hail. Protects against hail damage.
effect.full: During hail, this Pokémon has 1.25× its evasion, and it does not take hail damage regardless of type. The evasion bonus does not count as a stat modifier. Overworld: If the lead Pokémon has this ability, the wild encounter rate is halved in snow.

descriptions.zh: 原本ＨＰ变得很少时才会吃树果， 在ＨＰ还有一半时就会把它吃掉。
descriptions.hgss: Encourages the early use of a held Berry.

effect.short: Makes the Pokémon eat any held Berry triggered by low HP below 1/2 its max HP.
effect.full: This Pokémon eats any held Berry triggered by low HP when it falls below 50% of its HP, regardless of the Berry's usual threshold.

descriptions.zh: 要害被击中时， 会大发雷霆， 攻击力变为最大。
descriptions.hgss: Raises Attack upon taking a critical hit.

effect.short: Raises Attack to the maximum of six stages upon receiving a critical hit.
effect.full: Whenever this Pokémon receives a critical hit, its Attack rises to the maximum of 6 stages. This ability will still take effect if the critical hit is received by a Substitute.

descriptions.zh: 失去所持有的道具时， 速度会提高。
descriptions.hgss: Raises Speed if a held item is used.

effect.short: Doubles Speed upon using or losing a held item.
effect.full: When this Pokémon uses or loses its held item, its Speed is doubled. If it gains another item or leaves battle, this bonus is lost. This includes when the Pokémon drops its item because of Knock Off. This bonus does not count as a stat modifier. There is no notification when this ability takes effect.

descriptions.zh: 耐热的体质会 让火属性的招式威力减半。
descriptions.hgss: Weakens the power of Fire-type moves.

effect.short: Halves damage from Fire moves and burns.
effect.full: This Pokémon takes half as much damage from Fire-type moves and burns.

descriptions.zh: 能力变化会变为平时的２倍。
descriptions.hgss: The Pokémon is prone to wild stat changes.

effect.short: Doubles the Pokémon's stat modifiers. These doubled modifiers are still capped at -6 or 6 stages.
effect.full: Each stage of this Pokémon's stat modifiers acts as two stages. These doubled stages are still limited to a minimum of -6 and a maximum of 6. This Pokémon can still accumulate less than -3 or more than 3 stages of stat modifiers, even though the extra ones have no effect after doubling.

descriptions.zh: 下雨天气时和受到水属性的招式时， ＨＰ会回复。晴朗天气时和受到火属性的 招式时，ＨＰ会减少。
descriptions.hgss: Reduces HP if it is hot. Water restores HP.

effect.short: Causes 1/8 max HP in damage each turn during strong sunlight, but heals for 1/8 max HP during rain. Increases damage from Fire moves to 1.25×, but absorbs Water moves, healing for 1/4 max HP.
effect.full: This Pokémon takes 1/8 of its maximum HP in damage after each turn during strong sunlight, but it heals for 1/8 of its HP each turn during rain. This Pokémon takes 1.25× as much damage from Fire-type moves, but whenever a Water move hits it, it heals for 1/4 its maximum HP instead.

descriptions.zh: 比较对手的防御和特防， 根据较低的那项能力 相应地提高自己的攻击或特攻。
descriptions.hgss: Adjusts power according to the foe’s ability.

effect.short: Raises the attack stat corresponding to the opponents' weaker defense one stage upon entering battle.
effect.full: When this Pokémon enters battle, its Attack or Special Attack, whichever corresponds to its opponents' weaker total defensive stat, rises one stage. In the event of a tie, Special Attack is raised. This ability also takes effect when acquired during a battle.

descriptions.zh: 使用拳类招式的威力会提高。
descriptions.hgss: Boosts the power of punching moves.

effect.short: Strengthens punch-based moves to 1.2× their power.
effect.full: Moves flagged as being punch-based have 1.2× their base power for this Pokémon. Sucker Punch is not flagged as punch-based; its original, Japanese name only means "surprise attack".

descriptions.zh: 变为中毒状态时， ＨＰ不会减少，反而会增加起来。
descriptions.hgss: Restores HP if the Pokémon is poisoned.

effect.short: Heals for 1/8 max HP after each turn when poisoned in place of damage.
effect.full: If this Pokémon is poisoned, it will heal for 1/8 of its maximum HP after each turn rather than taking damage. This includes bad poison.

descriptions.zh: 与自身同属性的招式 威力会提高。
descriptions.hgss: Powers up moves of the same type.

effect.short: Increases the same-type attack bonus from 1.5× to 2×.
effect.full: This Pokémon inflicts twice as much damage with moves whose types match its own, rather than the usual same-type attack bonus of 1.5×.

descriptions.zh: 如果使用连续招式， 总是能使出最高次数。
descriptions.hgss: Increases the frequency of multi-strike moves.

effect.short: Extends two-to-five-hit moves and Triple Kick to their full length every time.
effect.full: This Pokémon always hits five times with two-to-five-hit moves, such as Icicle Spear. It also bypasses the accuracy checks on Triple Kick's second and third hits.

descriptions.zh: 下雨天气时， 异常状态会治愈。
descriptions.hgss: Heals status problems if it is raining.

effect.short: Cures any major status ailment after each turn during rain.
effect.full: This Pokémon is cured of any major status ailment after each turn during rain.

descriptions.zh: 晴朗天气时， 特攻会提高， 而每回合ＨＰ会减少。
descriptions.hgss: Boosts Sp. Atk, but lowers HP in sunshine.

effect.short: Increases Special Attack to 1.5× but costs 1/8 max HP after each turn during strong sunlight.
effect.full: During strong sunlight, this Pokémon has 1.5× its Special Attack but takes 1/8 of its maximum HP in damage after each turn.

descriptions.zh: 变为异常状态时， 速度会提高。
descriptions.hgss: Boosts Speed if there is a status problem.

effect.short: Increases Speed to 1.5× with a major status ailment.
effect.full: Whenever this Pokémon has a major status ailment, it has 1.5× its Speed. This Pokémon is not affected by the usual Speed cut from paralysis. Overworld: If the lead Pokémon has this ability, the wild encounter rate is halved.

descriptions.zh: 无论是什么属性的招式， 全部会变为一般属性。 威力会少量提高。
descriptions.hgss: All the Pokémon’s moves become the Normal type.

effect.short: Makes the Pokémon's moves all act Normal-type.
effect.full: This Pokémon's moves all act as if they were Normal-type. Moves that inflict typeless damage do so as usual. Moves of variable type, such as Hidden Power, are affected. They otherwise work as usual, however; Weather Ball, for example, is always forced to be Normal, but it still has doubled power and looks different during weather. As Thunder Wave is prevented by immunities, unlike most non-damaging moves, it does not affect Ghost-type Pokémon under the effect of this ability.

descriptions.zh: 击中要害时， 威力会变得更强。
descriptions.hgss: Powers up moves if they become critical hits.

effect.short: Strengthens critical hits to inflict 3× damage rather than 2×.
effect.full: This Pokémon inflicts triple damage with critical hits, rather than the usual double damage.

descriptions.zh: 不会受到攻击以外的伤害。
descriptions.hgss: The Pokémon only takes damage from attacks.

effect.short: Protects against damage not directly caused by a move.
effect.full: This Pokémon is immune to damage not directly caused by a move. For example, this Pokémon takes no damage from from weather, recoil, status ailments, or Spikes, but it still suffers from the Attack cut when burned, and a Life Orb will still power up this Pokémon's moves without damaging it. Anything that directly depends on such damage will also not happen; for example, Leech Seed will neither hurt this Pokémon nor heal the opponent, and Pokémon with a Jaboca Berry or Rowap Berry will not consume the berry when hit by this Pokémon. The following are unaffected: Struggle, Pain Split (whether used by or against this Pokémon), Belly Drum, Substitute, Curse, moves that knock the user out, and damage from confusion. This Pokémon will neither lose nor regain HP if it drains HP from a Pokémon with Liquid Ooze. If this Pokémon is badly poisoned, the poison counter is still increased each turn; if the Pokémon loses this ability, it will begin taking as much damage as it would be if it had been taking increasing damage each turn.

descriptions.zh: 由于无防守战术， 双方使出的招式都必定会击中。
descriptions.hgss: Ensures both Pokémon’s and foe’s attacks land.

effect.short: Ensures all moves used by and against the Pokémon hit.
effect.full: Moves used by or against this Pokémon never miss. One-hit KO moves are unaffected. Moves affected by this ability can hit Pokémon during the preparation turn of moves like Dig or Fly. Overworld: If the lead Pokémon has this ability, the wild encounter rate is doubled.

descriptions.zh: 使出招式的顺序 必定会变为最后。
descriptions.hgss: The Pokémon moves after even slower foes.

effect.short: Makes the Pokémon move last within its move's priority bracket.
effect.full: This Pokémon moves last within its priority bracket. Multiple Pokémon with this ability move in order of Speed amongst themselves. The Full Incense and Lagging Tail take precedence over this ability; that is, Pokémon with these items move after Pokémon with this ability. Pokémon with both this ability and one of these items are delayed as much as if they had only the item. This ability works as usual during Trick Room: Pokémon with this ability will move in reverse order of Speed after Pokémon without it.

descriptions.zh: 攻击时可以将 低威力招式的威力提高。
descriptions.hgss: Powers up the Pokémon’s weaker moves.

effect.short: Strengthens moves of 60 base power or less to 1.5× their power.
effect.full: This Pokémon's moves have 1.5× their power if their base power is 60 or less. This includes moves of variable power, such as Hidden Power and Magnitude, when their power is 60 or less. Helping Hand's power boost is taken into account for any move, as is Defense Curl's power boost for Rollout.

descriptions.zh: 晴朗天气时， 不会变为异常状态。
descriptions.hgss: Prevents problems with status in sunny weather.

effect.short: Protects against major status ailments during strong sunlight.
effect.full: This Pokémon cannot be given a major status ailment during strong sunlight. This ability does not heal prior status ailments. Rest will fail altogether with this ability in effect. Yawn will immediately fail if used on this Pokémon during strong sunlight, and an already-used Yawn will fail if the weather turns to strong sunlight in the meantime.

descriptions.zh: 无法使用持有的道具。
descriptions.hgss: The Pokémon can’t use any held items.

effect.short: Prevents the Pokémon from using its held item in battle.
effect.full: In battle, this Pokémon cannot use its held item, nor will the item have any passive effect on the battle, positive or negative. This Pokémon also cannot use Fling. The Speed cut from the Iron Ball and the effort items (the Macho Brace, Power Weight, Power Bracer, Power Belt, Power Lens, Power Band, and Power Anklet) is unaffected. Items that do not directly affect the battle, such as the Exp. Share, the Amulet Coin, or the Soothe Bell, work as usual. All held items work as usual out of battle. Other moves that use the held item, such as Natural Gift and Switcheroo, work as usual.

descriptions.zh: 可以不受对手特性的干扰， 向对手使出招式。
descriptions.hgss: Moves can be used regardless of abilities.

effect.short: Bypasses targets' abilities if they could hinder or prevent a move.
effect.full: This Pokémon's moves completely ignore abilities that could hinder or prevent their effect on the target. For example, this Pokémon's moves ignore abilities that would fully negate them, such as Water Absorb; abilities that would prevent any of their effects, such as Clear Body, Shell Armor, or Sticky Hold; and abilities that grant any general protective benefit, such as Simple, Snow Cloak, or Thick Fat. If an ability could either hinder or help this Pokémon's moves, e.g. Dry Skin or Unaware, the ability is ignored either way. Abilities that do not fit this description, even if they could hinder moves in some other way, are not affected. For example, Cursed Body only affects potential future uses of the move, while Liquid Ooze and Shadow Tag can only hinder a move's effect on the user. This ablity cannot ignore type or form changes granted by abilities, for example Color Change or Forecast; nor effects that were caused by abilities but are no longer tied to an ability, such as the rain from Drizzle. This ability cannot ignore Multitype at all. An ability ignored by this ability is only nullified while the move is being used. For example, this Pokémon's moves can paralyze a Pokémon with Limber, but Limber will activate and heal the paralysis immediately thereafter, and this Pokémon's Spikes are not affected by this ability after they have been placed. When this Pokémon enters battle, all participating trainers are notified that it has this ability. This ability functions identically to Teravolt and Turboblaze.

descriptions.zh: 因为拥有超幸运， 攻击容易击中对手的要害。
descriptions.hgss: Heightens the critical- hit ratios of moves.

effect.short: Raises moves' critical hit rates one stage.
effect.full: This Pokémon's moves have critical hit rates one stage higher than normal.

descriptions.zh: 变为濒死时， 会对接触到自己的对手造成伤害。
descriptions.hgss: Damages the foe landing the finishing hit.

effect.short: Damages the attacker for 1/4 its max HP when knocked out by a contact move.
effect.full: When this Pokémon is knocked out by a move that makes contact, the move's user takes 1/4 its maximum HP in damage.

descriptions.zh: 可以察觉到 对手拥有的危险招式。
descriptions.hgss: Senses the foe’s dangerous moves.

effect.short: Notifies all trainers upon entering battle if an opponent has a super-effective move, Self-Destruct, Explosion, or a one-hit KO move.
effect.full: When this Pokémon enters battle, if one of its opponents has a move that is super effective against it, Self-Destruct, Explosion, or a one-hit knockout move, all participating trainers are notified. The move itself is not revealed; only that there is such a move. Moves that inflict typeless damage, such as Future Sight, and moves of variable type, such as Hidden Power, count as their listed types. Counter, Metal Burst, Mirror Coat, and one-hit KO moves to which this Pokémon is immune do not trigger this ability.

descriptions.zh: 出场时， 只读取１个对手拥有的招式。
descriptions.hgss: Determines what moves the foe has.

effect.short: Reveals the opponents' strongest move upon entering battle.
effect.full: When this Pokémon enters battle, it reveals the move with the highest base power known by any opposing Pokémon to all participating trainers. In the event of a tie, one is chosen at random. Moves without a listed base power are assigned one as follows: Power | Moves ----: | ----- 160 | One-hit KO moves: Fissure, Guillotine, Horn Drill, and Sheer Cold 120 | Counter moves: Counter, Metal Burst, and Mirror Coat 80 | Variable power or set damage: Crush Grip, Dragon Rage, Electro Ball, Endeavor, Final Gambit, Flail, Frustration, Grass Knot, Gyro Ball, Heat Crash, Heavy Slam, Hidden Power, Low Kick, Natural Gift, Night Shade, Psywave, Return, Reversal, Seismic Toss, Sonic Boom, Trump Card, and Wring Out 0 | Any such move not listed

descriptions.zh: 可以无视对手能力的变化， 进行攻击。
descriptions.hgss: Ignores any change in ability by the foe.

effect.short: Ignores other Pokémon's stat modifiers for damage and accuracy calculation.
effect.full: This Pokémon ignores other Pokémon's stat modifiers for the purposes of damage and accuracy calculation. Effectively, this affects modifiers of every stat except Speed. The power of Punishment and Stored Power is calculated as usual. When this Pokémon hurts itself in confusion, its stat modifiers affect damage as usual.

descriptions.zh: 可以将效果不好的招式 以通常的威力使出。
descriptions.hgss: Powers up “not very effective” moves.

effect.short: Doubles damage inflicted with not-very-effective moves.
effect.full: This Pokémon deals twice as much damage with moves that are not very effective against the target.

descriptions.zh: 受到效果绝佳的攻击时， 可以减弱其威力。
descriptions.hgss: Reduces damage from supereffective attacks.

effect.short: Decreases damage taken from super-effective moves by 1/4.
effect.full: This Pokémon takes 0.75× as much damage from moves that are super effective against it. This ability functions identically to Solid Rock.

descriptions.zh: 在５回合内， 攻击和速度减半。
descriptions.hgss: Temporarily halves Attack and Speed.

effect.short: Halves Attack and Speed for five turns upon entering battle.
effect.full: This Pokémon's Attack and Speed are halved for five turns upon entering battle. This ability also takes effect when acquired during battle. If this Pokémon loses its ability before the five turns are up, its Attack and Speed return to normal; if it then regains this ability without leaving battle, its Attack and Speed are halved again, but the counter keeps counting from where it was.

descriptions.zh: 一般属性和格斗属性的招式 可以击中幽灵属性的宝可梦。
descriptions.hgss: Enables moves to hit Ghost-type foes.

effect.short: Lets the Pokémon's Normal and Fighting moves hit Ghost Pokémon.
effect.full: This Pokémon ignores Ghost-type Pokémon's immunity to Normal- and Fighting-type moves. Ghost Pokémon's other types affect damage as usual.

descriptions.zh: 将水属性的招式引到自己身上， 不会受到伤害，而是会提高特攻。
descriptions.hgss: The Pokémon draws in all Water-type moves.

effect.short: Redirects single-target Water moves to this Pokémon where possible. Absorbs Water moves, raising Special Attack one stage.
effect.full: All other Pokémon's single-target Water-type moves are redirected to this Pokémon, if it is an eligible target. Other Pokémon's Water moves raise this Pokémon's Special Attack one stage, negating any other effect on it, and cannot miss it. If the move's intended target also has this ability, the move is not redirected. When multiple Pokémon with this ability are possible targets for redirection, the move is redirected to the one with the highest Speed stat, or, in the case of a tie, to a random tied Pokémon. Follow Me takes precedence over this ability.

descriptions.zh: 冰雹天气时， 会缓缓回复ＨＰ。
descriptions.hgss: The Pokémon regains HP in a hailstorm.

effect.short: Heals for 1/16 max HP after each turn during hail. Protects against hail damage.
effect.full: This Pokémon heals for 1/16 of its maximum HP after each turn during hail, and it does not take hail damage regardless of type.

descriptions.zh: 受到效果绝佳的攻击时， 可以减弱其威力。
descriptions.hgss: Reduces damage from supereffective attacks

effect.short: Decreases damage taken from super-effective moves by 1/4.
effect.full: This Pokémon takes 0.75× as much damage from moves that are super effective against it. This ability functions identically to Filter.

descriptions.zh: 出场时， 会将天气变为冰雹。
descriptions.hgss: The Pokémon summons a hailstorm in battle.

effect.short: Summons hail that lasts indefinitely upon entering battle.
effect.full: The weather changes to hail when this Pokémon enters battle and does not end unless cancelled by another weather condition. If multiple Pokémon with this ability, Drizzle, Drought, or Sand Stream are sent out at the same time, the abilities will activate in order of Speed, respecting Trick Room. Each ability's weather will cancel the previous weather, and only the weather summoned by the slowest of the Pokémon will stay.

descriptions.zh: 战斗结束时， 有时候会捡来甜甜蜜。
descriptions.hgss: The Pokémon may gather Honey from somewhere.

effect.short: The Pokémon may pick up Honey after battle.
effect.full: This Pokémon has a chance of picking up Honey after each battle. This chance starts at 5% and rises another 5% after every tenth level: 5% from level 1–10, 10% from 11–20, and so on, up to 50% from 91–100. This ability is checked after the battle ends, at which point any temporary ability changes have worn off.

descriptions.zh: 出场时， 可以察觉对手的持有物。
descriptions.hgss: The Pokémon can check the foe’s held item.

effect.short: Reveals an opponent's held item upon entering battle.
effect.full: When this Pokémon enters battle, it reveals an opposing Pokémon's held item to all participating trainers. In a double battle, if one opponent has an item, this Pokémon will Frisk that Pokémon; if both have an item, it will Frisk one at random.

descriptions.zh: 自己会因反作用力受伤的招式， 其威力会提高。
descriptions.hgss: Powers up moves that have recoil damage.

effect.short: Strengthens recoil moves to 1.2× their power.
effect.full: This Pokémon's recoil moves and crash moves have 1.2× their base power. Struggle is unaffected. The "crash moves" are the moves that damage the user upon missing: Jump Kick and High Jump Kick.

descriptions.zh: 自己的属性会根据持有的石板 或Ｚ纯晶的属性而改变。
descriptions.hgss: Changes type to match the held Plate.

effect.short: Changes Arceus's type and form to match its held Plate.
effect.full: If this Pokémon is holding an elemental Plate, its type and form change to match the Plate. This Pokémon's held item, whether or not it is a Plate, cannot be taken by Covet or Thief, nor removed by Knock Off, nor traded by Switcheroo or Trick. Covet, Thief, and Knock Off still inflict damage against this Pokémon. Unlike with Sticky Hold, this Pokémon cannot use Fling, Switcheroo, or Trick to lose its item itself, nor gain an item through Switcheroo or Trick if it does not have one. This ability has no effect for any Pokémon other than Arceus. This ability cannot be traded with Skill Swap, nor copied with Role Play or Trace, nor disabled with Gastro Acid, nor changed with Worry Seed. This Pokémon cannot use Skill Swap or Role Play to lose its ability itself. Mold Breaker cannot ignore this ability. If a Pokémon Transforms into an Arceus with this ability, it will Transform into Arceus's default, Normal-type form. If the Transforming Pokémon is holding a Plate, this ability will then activate and change the Pokémon into the corresponding form.

descriptions.zh: 晴朗天气时， 自己与同伴的攻击和 特防能力会提高。
descriptions.hgss: Powers up party Pokémon when it is sunny.

effect.short: Increases friendly Pokémon's Attack and Special Defense to 1.5× during strong sunlight.
effect.full: Friendly Pokémon have 1.5× their Attack and Special Defense during strong sunlight if any friendly Pokémon has this ability. Unlike Forecast, Multitype, and Zen Mode, this ability is not tied to its Pokémon's form change; Cherrim will switch between its forms even if it loses this ability. As such, this ability also works if obtained by a Pokémon other than Cherrim.

descriptions.zh: 给予睡眠状态的对手伤害。
descriptions.hgss: Reduces a sleeping foe’s HP.

effect.short: Damages sleeping opponents for 1/8 their max HP after each turn.
effect.full: Opposing Pokémon take 1/8 of their maximum HP in damage after each turn while they are asleep.
